data.body:
[P1] Include pre-launch faults in the retirement audit

If setup installs a fault and fails before `record_attempt`, retained evidence can contain only `faultsCreated`. This guard ignores that inventory, so `retire` returning `True` releases the target without independent release evidence. Final validation is also skipped for the failed case, allowing subsequent cases onto a potentially faulted target. Include `faultsCreated` and other inventories revealing owned work, such as `histories`, in the reconciliation decision; require audited retirement or quarantine. Add a regression for setup failure after creating a fault but before launching an invocation.
